module: Tools shared by the pause menu routeData providers: navigation by state sequence, button registration via ui_pause_actions, exit confirmation (level or game) adapted to career, execution of an exit with prior save, and building of rail groups. The confirmation text ids are exposed in ExitLevelTexts and ExitGameTexts.
notes: asRailGroup returns nil (and not an empty group) when the action list is empty: this prevents the JSON from encoding the actions as an object instead of an array.

withExitConfirm in career: if a save exists, confirmText = {txt = texts.career} and confirmSince = save date (the UI fills {{time}}); otherwise notSaved text, and if career_career.isAutosaveEnabled() the button offers "Save and quit" (confirmDestructive = false) with a "Quit without saving" option (altLabel).
registerPauseButton requires ui_pause_actions to be loaded (unprotected global variable).

ExitLevelTexts.desc: Translation ids for quitting the level: default, career, notSaved.

ExitGameTexts.desc: Translation ids for quitting the game: default, career, notSaved.

bool.desc: Converts any value to a boolean (truthy -> true, otherwise false).

tryPushStateSequence.desc: Tries to navigate to each state via ui_router.navigate (in a pcall) until one succeeds (result.result ~= false).

states.desc: State name or list of states to try in order.

registerPauseButton.desc: Registers a pause button: extracts button.callback, copies the rest of the metadata and calls ui_pause_actions.registerButton. Without a callback, uses a function that returns false.

returns.desc: Registered metadata (with buttonId) or nil if button is nil.

withExitConfirm.desc: Completes an exit button with the confirmation fields (cancelLabel, confirmText, confirmSince, confirmLabel, altLabel...) depending on the mode (career or not) and the save state.

runExit.desc: Executes the exit function; if payload.saveFirst is true, first saves the career via ui_pause_actions.saveCareerThen.

asRailGroup.desc: Creates a rail group {id, actions}, or nil if the list is empty.
